personal.preferred_title: Senior Python / SQL Developer | AWS, Pandas, Large Datasets & Financial Systems

summary: Senior Python and SQL technology professional with 20+ years of enterprise experience across Python, Pandas, SQL, AWS data platforms, large dataset processing, data validation, financial-services systems, production troubleshooting, automation, and stakeholder reporting. Strong background building Python-driven data workflows, optimizing SQL/reporting layers, validating large operational datasets, documenting support processes, and working in regulated enterprise environments. Best aligned to Python/SQL roles requiring Pandas/NumPy-style data processing, AWS, advanced SQL, financial-domain data workflows, testing awareness, and production data reliability; Flask/backend application ownership, GitLab/Jenkins/Docker/CI-CD, Java, formal OOP design patterns, and algorithm-heavy software engineering are positioned carefully as adjacent or working-knowledge areas rather than overstated production ownership.
